Hi Olga,

Thanks for hopping on the discovery call earlier. We need to get operator provisioning wired for our Private Control Plane (VPC deployment) so our infra team can manage clusters in our VPC. Key asks from our side:

- SCIM provisioning for operator users and service principals (we plan to add machine/service accounts automatically).
- SAML attribute mapping for role assignment (we want to map "redwood:operator" to our AD groups).
- Auditability: all operator actions must be logged to our Splunk instance.

Can you share the mapping format you expect and any constraints on usernames/unique IDs? Also curious if you support a fallback where we can create short-lived service tokens (if SCIM lag occurs during cutover).

Thanks,
Sarah

Subject: Re: Initial: operator accounts + SCIM + SAML attributes for Private CP

Sarah —

Thanks, this is actionable. I attached a short spec that shows the SCIM schema we consume and a proposed operator role matrix (privcp-scim-mapping-spec.xlsx). High level notes: 

- SCIM: we accept enterprise SCIM 2.0; primary identifier is externalId (recommended: <company>:<uuid>). We also accept mail and userName. Account update operations (PATCH) are supported.
- SAML: we consume a string attribute 'redwood_roles' or a multi-valued attribute 'redwood:roles'. We match by exact group name and then map to internal RBAC roles: operator, read-only-operator, auditor.
- Service principals: for machine/service accounts we prefer SCIM for lifecycle but provide a short-lived token fallback (15m max) generated by the Private Control Plane auth proxy during cutover. Fallback requires an allowlist of caller IPs and an approver.
- Audit logs: we stream Admin API audit events (JSON lines) to a customer-managed HTTPS endpoint or to a forwarder we can ship to your Splunk HEC token. We require a TLS client cert for Splunk HEC ingestion option.

Action items I propose:
1) Your team provides a sample SCIM CSV export (username, externalId, groups) — I'll validate and return a mapping.
2) Rishi to propose the SAML attribute mapping formatter and any transformation rules.
3) Mina to call out operator onboarding playbook and fallback token guardrails.
4) Schedule a runbook review (30–45m) to confirm timeline.

We attached operator-role-matrix.md as well.

- Olga

Olga Petrov

Hi all,

Quick technical suggestion on SAML attributes to reduce friction during mapping:

- If Acme can emit a single URI attribute (urn:oid:1.2.840.113556.1.4.7000.123:RedwoodRoles) containing a comma-separated set (e.g., "operator,viewer") that's easiest for our parser.
- We also support multi-valued 'redwood:role' attributes if that's how your IdP is configured.
- For group-to-role mapping, avoid using display names that change frequently; map by stable ADCN or group GUID when possible — SCIM externalId -> groupGUID is ideal.

On the service principal side: our SCIM SCHEMA supports an 'entitlements' array; set entitlements to ['service'] and we will auto-create a machine account that cannot do interactive login. Token fallback we mentioned earlier will record an approver header + rotation metadata; this meets many audit requirements but is not intended as long-term provisioning.

I'll draft a tiny transform script we can run during onboarding to normalize group IDs — will drop it in the Jira ticket referenced below.

— Rishi

Hi team —

Couple of pragmatic guardrails from ops: 

- During cutover we recommend a "two-owner" approval for any service principal creation via fallback tokens. Approver must be listed in the SCIM group 'privcp-admins' and approval is recorded in the audit event.
- Certificate rotation: Private CP expects customer TLS certs (for control plane endpoints) to be rotated before 90 days. We'll provide a webhook to receive rotation notifications and validate cert chains.
- We should test provisioning at scale: please share an exported SCIM file with ~500 test rows so we can exercise batching and patch semantics.

I can own the runbook and a short playbook for emergency rollback. Proposed date for runbook review: Tue 2028-01-17 10:00 PT.

Mina
